# Santiago Castro

> Santiago Castro is a Research Scientist at Netflix with a PhD in Computer Science from the University of Michigan. His research focuses on holistically representing multimodal sources (especially Vision and Language) for general-purpose applications and video tasks, as well as Computational Humor.
